legal_name: Q LAND FOOD LLP (as claimed; not independently verified in MCA/LLP registry)
note: Registry verification could not be completed. The DuckDuckGo search backend returned connection errors ('searx: Connection refused') for all queries, and direct fetches of registry aggregators (zaubacorp.com, thecompanycheck.com, instafinancials.com) returned HTTP 403 Forbidden; Google returned HTTP 429 and the MCA/LLP portal host (llp.gov.in) did not resolve. Bing returned only irrelevant results for the exact-name queries, i.e. no indexed public profile for 'Q LAND FOOD LLP' was surfaced. Therefore LLPIN/CIN, PAN, GSTIN, GST status, incorporation date, registered-office state, MCA status and revenue are all reported as null — NOT because they were checked and found absent, but because no public source could be read. No identifiers were inferred or constructed. Per project rules the entity is NOT rejected: non-existence/strike-off/liquidation/bankruptcy was not established, only unverified. Role is 'unknown' (no evidence of manufacturing vs trading activity was obtainable). Declared HS 120242 (ground-nut kernels, not roasted/otherwise cooked) and 120262 (ground-nut, shelled, other) are oilseed/groundnut codes consistent with a food/FMCG trader or processor, but HS alignment is not a rejection ground and the actual code must be confirmed against the company's own GST/export documentation. Recommended next step: manual lookup on the MCA portal (mca.gov.in / llp.gov.in) by exact LLP name, and GSTIN verification on the GST portal, before any commercial decision.
